ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two cascaded flip-flops, the left side is labeled FF1, and the right side is labeled FF2. The inverted output of FF1 is fed back to its D input, therefore FF1 is connected as a toggle flip-flop; the input clock CP is connected to the clock terminal of FF1. The output of FF1 is then sent to the right-side FF2, and FF2 forms the next counting/toggling stage, with the right-side output terminal labeled Q2. Reasoning: The question stem gives the frequency of the input clock CP as 1 kHz, i.e. 1000 Hz. FF1 is a toggle flip-flop, and toggles once for each valid clock edge, so its output Q1 frequency is half of CP: 1000/2 = 500 Hz. FF2, as the next-stage toggling stage, again divides this valid frequency by 2, therefore the frequency of Q2 is 500/2 = 250 Hz.

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure: FF1 is wired as a toggle flip-flop because D receives the inverted output, and FF2 forms the next toggle/counting stage, with Q2 as its output. method.method_draft: First describe the image structure and translate it into transitions. From FF1 feedback, write Q1(next) = not Q1, so Q1 alternates every CP pulse. From the FF2 JK connection controlled by Q1, Q2 holds on one CP pulse and toggles on the next, so its sequence repeats after four input clock pulses. Therefore the period of Q2 is 4 times the CP period. Read CP = 1000 Hz from the text, so f(Q2) = 1000/4 = 250 Hz.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个触发器，左侧为 FF1，右侧为 FF2。FF1 的时钟端接输入 CP，FF1 的反馈连接使其 D 输入由自身反相输出反馈，因此可写成 Q1(next)=not Q1。FF1 的 Q1 输出再接到右侧 FF2 的 JK 控制输入，使 FF2 在由 Q1 控制的相邻时钟脉冲中一次保持、一次翻转。推理：由于 FF1 满足 Q1(next)=not Q1，所以 Q1 每来一个 CP 脉冲翻转一次，即 Q1 的周期为 2 个 CP 周期。FF2 的 JK 输入受 Q1 控制，因此 FF2 的 Q2 不是每个 CP 脉冲都翻转，而是一个 CP 脉冲保持、下一个 CP 脉冲翻转，其完整状态序列需要 4 个 CP 脉冲重复一次。因此 Q2 的周期是 CP 周期的 4 倍。已知 CP 频率为 1 kHz = 1000 Hz，所以 f(Q2)=1000/4=250 Hz。
